## Install

1. Download **youtube-watched-hider-*.zip** below and unzip it to a folder you'll keep (Chrome loads the extension from there).
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the unzipped folder.

**Updating:** unzip the new version over the same folder, then click the reload ↻ icon on the extension's card in `chrome://extensions`. Your settings are kept.
